director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket pitch jaise number line par fractions rakhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
haan, samajh aaya

Cricket pitch ko ek number line socho: ek stump 0 par hai aur doosra stump 1 par. Batsman run ke liye bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka bhi ek number hota hai. Theek hai Riya—cricket pitch ko 0 se 1 tak ka ek poora stretch socho.
haan samajh gayi
Screen par 0 se 1 ki line hai, aur theek beech mein ek mark. Yeh mark 0 se 1 ko 2 barabar gaps mein baant raha hai, aur is mark ka naam 1/2 hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara

Cricket yaad rahega; yeh sawaal khatam karke uspar aate hain. Is baat par isi question ke turant baad wapas aayenge. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: near 3

Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Screen par ghar se chai ki dukaan tak 0 se 1 km ki sadak hai, aur khilona beech wale mark par ruka hai. Woh ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka number 1/2 km hai, 0 aur 1 ke beech. Ab tak samajh aaya?
mujhe nahi pata

Khilona sadak ke ek pakke spot par khada hai. Us spot ka bhi ek number hai, jo 0 aur 1 ke beech hai. Wahi 0 se 1 km ki sadak ab 8 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Khilona pehle hisse ke end par ruka. Woh kis number par hai?
director.card: Wahi 0 se 1 km ki sadak ab 8 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Khilona pehle hisse ke end par ruka. Woh kis number par hai?

director.text: 1/8 km hai na
Haan, sahi hai, kyunki sadak 8 barabar hisson mein hai, toh pehle hisse ka end 1/8 km par hai.
haan, woh maine bata diya
Achha. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: 0 aur 1

Bilkul sahi, kyunki 1/3 ka matlab 0 se 1 ke 3 barabar gaps mein se pehla gap, toh woh isi line par hai. Sixer maara—nice, ball seedha boundary ke paar gayi hogi! Screen par wahi 0 se 1 ki line hai, aur line ke upar ab beech mein 3 marks hain. Marks nahi, gaps dekho: 4 barabar gaps hain, isliye 0 ke baad pehla mark 1/4 hai. Isi line ke neeche ki taraf beech mein 7 marks hain. Ab tak samajh aaya?
aapko virat pasand hai?
Virat yaad rahega; yeh sawaal khatam karke uspar aate hain. Isi line ke neeche ki taraf 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par hain. Neeche ki taraf line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?
director.card: Isi line ke neeche ki taraf 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par hain. Neeche ki taraf line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?

director.text: 7 sahi nahi hai. Screen par 0 se 1 metre tak ka ribbon hai, beech mein 3 chalk ke nishaan hain, aur ribbon 4 barabar hisson mein bata hai. Pehla nishaan wahan hai jahan pehla barabar hissa khatam hota hai, isliye woh 1/4 metre par hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
haan, samajh aaya
1 metre ke ribbon par beech mein 7 chalk ke nishaan barabar doori par hain. Pehla nishaan kitne metre par hai?
director.card: 1 metre ke ribbon par beech mein 7 chalk ke nishaan barabar doori par hain. Pehla nishaan kitne metre par hai?

director.text: mujhe nahi pata
Nishaan nahi, unke beech ke gaps gino. 7 nishaan se gaps hamesha ek zyada bante hain. 1 metre ke ribbon par beech mein 7 chalk ke nishaan barabar doori par hain. Pehla nishaan kitne metre par hai?
director.card: 1 metre ke ribbon par beech mein 7 chalk ke nishaan barabar doori par hain. Pehla nishaan kitne metre par hai?

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 7 nishaan ribbon ke 8 barabar hisse banaate hain, aur pehla nishaan pehle hisse ke end par, yaani 1/8 metre par hai. Isi line ke neeche ki taraf 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par hain. Neeche ki taraf line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?

Bilkul sahi, kyunki beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain, 7 + 1 = 8.
aapko virat pasand hai?
Riya, main AI hoon, isliye meri personal pasand nahi hoti. Ab batao, 7 marks se 8 gaps kaise pata chala?
jo aapne dikhaya tha, usse socha
Achha. Screen par 0 se 1 ki line ab 8 barabar gaps mein bati hai, toh har gap pehle se chhota gap hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, bilkul 0 ke paas, aur beech wala mark abhi bhi 1/2 hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
Hindi mein bolo
Achha, ab Hindi mein baat karte hain. Agar yahi rekha 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?

director.text: 1/5 sahi nahi hai. Screen par 0 se 1 ki ek hi rekha par teen nishaan hain: 1/2, 1/4 aur 1/8, aur 1/8 bilkul 0 ke paas hai. Neeche ka number jitna bada, hissa utna chhota, aur woh 0 ke utna paas rukta hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
pata nahi

Neeche ka number jitna bada, hissa utna chhota. Isliye 1/8, 1/4 aur 1/2 mein 1/8 sabse chhota hai aur 0 ke sabse paas hai. Screen par 0 se 1 ki rekha par 1/3 ka nishaan hai. 1/6 kahaan aayega: 0 aur 1/3 ke beech, ya 1/3 ke baad?

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 1/6 ka hissa 1/3 ke hisse ka aadha hai, toh 1/6, 0 aur 1/3 ke beech rukta hai. Main AI teacher hoon, toh meri apni koi pasand nahi — Virat tumhari pasand hai, yeh main yaad rakhungi. Agar yahi rekha 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?
director.card: Agar yahi rekha 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?

director.text: Bilkul sahi, kyunki 10 barabar gaps ka har gap 5 gaps wale gap se chhota hai, toh 1/10, 0 ke zyada paas rukta hai. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 km par. Ghar aur school ke beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par lage hain. Pehla khamba ghar se kitne km door hai? Diya hai: ghar 0 par, school 1 km par, beech mein 3 khambe, barabar doori par. Dhoondhna hai: pehle khambe ki ghar se doori, km mein. Ab agla kadam dekhte hain.
hmm, achha
Pehla kadam dekho. Rekha banao aur ghar ko 0 par, school ko 1 par likho: 0 se 1 tak ki rekha, kyunki 0 se 1 tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
mujhe lagta hai haan
Ab doosra kadam. Khambe nahi, beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe, toh 4 barabar hisse, kyunki beech ke nishaan se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain. Ab isse aage chalte hain.
haan samajh gayi
Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se theek ek gap door hai. Toh pehla khamba kitne km par hai?
director.card: Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se theek ek gap door hai. Toh pehla khamba kitne km par hai?

1/3 km sahi nahi hai. Poora 1 km 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai. Pehla khamba ek gap door hai, toh ek gap ka naam socho. Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se theek ek gap door hai. Toh pehla khamba kitne km par hai?
director.card: Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se theek ek gap door hai. Toh pehla khamba kitne km par hai?

Haan, sahi hai. Toh poora jawab: pehla khamba ghar se 1/4 km door hai, kyunki raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, har gap 1/4 km ka, aur pehla khamba 0 se ek gap par hai. Screen par 0 se 1 tak ki rekha hai, aur beech mein 2 nishaan barabar doori par hain. 0 ke baad pehla nishaan kaunsa bhinn hai?

Bilkul sahi, kyunki beech ke 2 nishaan rekha ko 3 barabar gaps mein baantte hain, aur pehla nishaan ek gap par hai, yaani 1/3. Ek baar 0 se 1 ko 3 barabar gaps mein baanto, ek baar 10 barabar gaps mein. 0 ke zyada paas kaun hai: 1/3 ya 1/10?

director.text: 1/10 hai na
Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki 10 gaps wala hissa 3 gaps wale hisse se chhota hai, toh 1/10, 0 ke zyada paas rukta hai. 0 se 3 tak ki sankhya rekha par 1/2 kin do poore numbers ke beech aata hai?
director.card: 0 se 3 tak ki sankhya rekha par 1/2 kin do poore numbers ke beech aata hai?

director.text: 0 aur 1 ke beech

Haan, sahi: 1/2, 0 aur 1 ke beech hota hai, kyunki 1/2 ek poore ka aadha hai, toh woh 0 aur 1 ke beech aata hai. Ab tak humne 0 se sirf ek gap liya, jaise 1/4. Agle hisse mein 0 se 2 ya 3 gap chalenge, aur upar ka number batayega ki kitne gap chalna hai. Ab aage chalte hain.
